name: Deep One Hybrid

talents.name: Amphibious Hide
talents.description: Ignores the Uncomfortable quality of being fully submerged, and treats water as flat ground for movement purposes.

traits: Bulging eyes, webbed clawed hands, a faint fishy reek that lingers in any room it's stood in.
notes: Toughened-tier. Vulnerable to fire; will not willingly fight far from open water.
